summary: A 1934 CCC-built, 80-foot lookout in St. Louis County, listed as standing and registered in 2021; sources disagree on the forest (Kabetogama State Forest per Wikidata, Superior National Forest per Forest Lookouts). No staffing, fire or access records were found.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register spells it Vermillion; the Forest Fire Lookout Association list spells it Vermilion. The record keeps the register's spelling.
The register calls it a stairway lookout and Forest Lookouts calls it a steel tower. Both describe the same 80-foot structure built by the CCC in 1934.
Wikidata places the lookout in Kabetogama State Forest; Forest Lookouts lists it in the Superior National Forest. The story reports both and does not choose between them.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: no staffing, fire, access or rental sources were found. The Minnesota fire-tower index at kjackson.us had no match for this lookout. Wikidata's linked blog post was not read. The register's photo (August 2016, credit Jacob Hufnagle) has no URL or licence in the text, so no photo was added. The brief's record matches the sources, so no corrections are proposed. Staffing and access are omitted because no source gives them. The forest is disputed: Wikidata gives Kabetogama State Forest and Forest Lookouts gives Superior National Forest; the story reports both without choosing.
